entries.title: Executive, platform team
entries.description: Supporting client-side technology operations on a platform team through Quess Corp — application monitoring, deployment activities and the documentation that goes with them, working alongside the technical teams that own the delivery process.

entries.title: GitOps & Observability Platform
entries.description: A multi-node KIND cluster that reconciles itself from git: Go microservice with Prometheus RED metrics in a minimal non-root image, parameterised Helm chart with HPA and ServiceMonitor, GitHub Actions gating on kubeconform, Helm lint and GHCR publishing, Argo CD with self-healing, and Grafana fed by kube-prometheus-stack plus Loki/Promtail.

entries.title: Book Inventory REST API
entries.description: A deliberately small Go service, used to check whether a new idea about testing, tracing or deployment survives contact with something real.

entries.title: DevOps Engineer Intern
entries.description: Two months on containerised and web-based application deployment: Docker-based backend services, Go REST APIs, and Kubernetes deployments practised end to end rather than shipped to production.
